description:
Gully Project – Stitching Classes
Under women empowerment, our Club conducts ongoing stitching classes for 100 women at Ganesh Murthi Nagar Cuffe Parade. This has resulted in an additional source of income for them. This is an ongoing project for last three years.
We hope to sponsor more women for the stitching courses
Project cost Rs 3 lakhs @ Rs 25,000 per month
